method: Group tube side with its named start/end caps; weld coincident render seams; omit collapsed triangles; audit undirected edge incidence and winding within each assembled component.
limits: Grid welding is tolerance-dependent and can miss nearby points across cell boundaries.
No intersection, self-intersection or connected-component classification.
A closed oriented edge-incidence result alone does not prove a valid solid.
Signed volumes of open parts are not accepted physical volumes and are not summed.
No complete-body union or mass fitting.
